title: Host a District Walking Tour
flavor: Neighborhood leaders walk you down the shopping street: shutters, shop signs, and a great many questions.

title: Charity Dinner
flavor: A long table, a modest hall and a guest list of local business owners who would like to be seen with you.

title: Local Newspaper Advertisement
flavor: The regional paper offers a half page. The sales representative is very persuasive.

title: National Television Spot
flavor: A producer has thirty seconds of prime time and a price list.

title: Community Grant
flavor: The local associations all have a project. You can fund one.

title: Weekend Rally
flavor: The hall is booked and a few hundred chairs are set out. The question is how you want to be remembered.

title: A Journalist Calls
flavor: A reporter you have never met asks for a few minutes about the week in the Assembly.

title: A Question About the Street
flavor: A shopkeeper stops you outside the station. The road surface has been broken for years, and everyone keeps talking about a faster train but nobody says who pays.

title: Neighborhood Festival Invitation
flavor: The association is holding its festival on the weekend and has saved you a place at the head table.

title: A Rumor in the Hall
flavor: Something you said, or something people think you said, is travelling the corridors.

title: A Constituent Writes
flavor: A handwritten letter from a resident arrives with a stamp that was clearly licked twice.

title: The Treasurer Drops By
flavor: The party treasurer stops at your door and mentions, pleasantly, that the dues are coming.
